pages.text: One glass bottle, two uranium nuggets. It stacks to sixteen, because one is never enough.

pages.title: The Uranium Rush
pages.text: Drink it — yes, even on a full stomach; it's a buff, not a meal — and the $(thing)Uranium Rush$() hits: twenty seconds of $(thing)Glowing$(), $(thing)Night Vision$() and $(thing)Speed II$(), with the empty bottle handed politely back. Not poison. Never poison.$(p)A Nether researcher named Haskov drank the first one and asked for another. The advancement is named after his condition.

pages.title: The Glowing Pot
pages.text: Pour a few bottles into an Amendments cauldron and the pot fills with $(thing)Liquid Uranium$() — acid green and genuinely glowing, light for the whole alchemy corner. Right-click the pot with empty glass bottles to draw the drink back out whenever the mood strikes.$(p)This is the intended supply line: brew a pot once, bottle it forever.

pages.title: No, the Condenser Can't Have It
pages.text: Bottled Uranium carries no EMC, deliberately — the full ledger lives in $(l:orespawn_integrations:always_uranium/uranium_economy)The Uranium Economy$(). The condenser doesn't get to print a triple-buff drink by the stack; you get yours from the glowing pot like a person of culture.
